issue.body:
No backend can execute the attached StableHLO module, yet the module compiles cleanly: `CPU (compile-only)`, `GPU (compile-only)` (`hlo_runner_main --run=false`) accept and compile it without error. Failure signature: `collective_ops_utils.cc:499 N <= replica_id && replica_id < replica_count N N`.

The following backends fail without a crash signal:

- `run_hlo_module` on GPU (StableHLO input) — failed (rc=255)
- `run_hlo_module` on CPU (HLO proto input) — failed (rc=255)
- `run_hlo_module` on GPU (HLO proto input) — failed (rc=255)

The module also compiles cleanly on:

- `hlo_runner_main` on CPU (HLO proto input, compile-only via `--run=false`)
- `hlo_runner_main` on GPU (HLO proto input, compile-only via `--run=false`)

The StableHLO→HLO-proto conversion:

- `hlo-translate` — succeeds

**Command:**

```
hlo-translate \
  --mlir-to-hlo \
  --emit-proto \
  9b1af54d50daa2c1.mlir \
  -o \
  9b1af54d50daa2c1.hlo
sed -i '1{/^goo\.gle\//d}' 9b1af54d50daa2c1.hlo
```

## Environment

- **CPU**: `Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-14900HX`
- **GPU**: `NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU`
- **CUDA Driver**: `580.126.09`
- **XLA commit**: `6f1f2d916dcef0428bfa7ea66765be539126c4f2`
- **StableHLO commit**: `e6f81ebd06b3509f2c7fa6175430aadbd4d724ca`

## IR

```mlir
module {

    %2 = stablehlo.reshape %1 : (tensor<6x6xf32>) -> tensor<36xf32>
    %3 = stablehlo.slice %2 [0:32] : (tensor<36xf32>) -> tensor<32xf32>
    %4 = stablehlo.reshape %3 : (tensor<32xf32>) -> tensor<4x8xf32>
    %5 = call @wrapped_2408(%4) : (tensor<4x8xf32>) -> tensor<4x4xf32>
    %6 = stablehlo.convert %5 : (tensor<4x4xf32>) -> tensor<4x4xf64>
    %7 = stablehlo.reshape %6 : (tensor<4x4xf64>) -> tensor<16xf64>
    %8 = stablehlo.reshape %7 : (tensor<16xf64>) -> tensor<1x16xf64>
    %9 = stablehlo.broadcast_in_dim %8, dims = [0, 1] : (tensor<1x16xf64>) -> tensor<3x16xf64>
    %10 = stablehlo.reshape %9 : (tensor<3x16xf64>) -> tensor<48xf64>
    %11 = stablehlo.slice %10 [0:36] : (tensor<48xf64>) -> tensor<36xf64>
    %12 = stablehlo.reshape %11 : (tensor<36xf64>) -> tensor<6x6xf64>
    return %12 : tensor<6x6xf64>
  }
  func.func private @wrapped_2408(%arg0: tensor<4x8xf32>) -> tensor<4x4xf32> {
    %0 = "stablehlo.reduce_scatter"(%arg0) <{replica_groups = dense<[[0, 1]]> : tensor<1x2xi64>, scatter_dimension = 1 : i64}> ({
    ^bb0(%arg1: tensor<f32>, %arg2: tensor<f32>):
      %1 = stablehlo.add %arg1, %arg2 : tensor<f32>
      stablehlo.return %1 : tensor<f32>
    }) : (tensor<4x8xf32>) -> tensor<4x4xf32>
    return %0 : tensor<4x4xf32>
  }
}
```
